data.name: Frontline Fury - Trenches, Mud & Blood
data.detailed_description:
Mud, blood and relentless gunfire - welcome to the trenches. Frontline Fury - Trenches, Mud & Blood is a ruthless top-down World War II shooter that gives you nothing for free. Every shot could be your last - fight smart or die trying.

Forget regenerating health bars and Hollywood heroes. Here, you’re just a soldier thrown into a brutal war of chaos and filth. Ammo is scarce, enemies are unforgiving, and cover is often your only chance at survival.

Whether it’s close combat, flanking enemy positions, or desperately reloading under heavy fire - Frontline Fury will test your nerves, your tactics and your timing.

What to expect:

  • Authentic WWII atmosphere - trenches, mud, smoke and screams

  • Tactical top-down action - use cover, flank enemies and survive brutal encounters

  • Realistic weapons & deadly ballistics - weapon choice matters, every shot counts

  • Level & skills - upgrade your soldier to endure the horrors of the front

  • Aggressive AI - enemies flank, suppress and react - you need to think tactically

  • Hardcore & unforgiving - mistakes are punished instantly

  • Survival at the core - scarce ammo, limited supplies and fragile health

  • Dark & gritty setting - uncompromising, dirty, intense

Demo & Community

  • The Demo is live - with 89% positive reviews so far.

  • Play the first 15 minutes and feel the brutal intensity of our WWII top-down shooter.

We’re a small indie team - your feedback matters. Play the demo, share your thoughts on Discord or Steam, and help us make Frontline Fury even more brutal and better.

data.short_description: Mud, blood and bullets – step into the unforgiving chaos of World War II in a brutal top-down shooter where every decision can be fatal. Use cover, outsmart your enemies, and fight for survival with tactics, precision and nerves of steel.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Turkish, Vietnamese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core Intel Core i5-3470 (4 * 3200) or equivalent / AMD FX-8350 (4 * 4000) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 660 ( 2048 MB) / Radeon R9 390X (8192 MB)
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Minimum Specification listed above allows gameplay experience close to 30 FPS on average while using 1080p resolution and lowest settings

content_descriptors.notes:
Warning: Intense Violence & Gore

This game contains graphic depictions of violence, blood, and gore. Player discretion is advised. Not suitable for children or those sensitive to violent content.
